name: Moed
description: Bring Moed engagement context and follow-up actions into Mattermost.

settings_schema.header: Connect this Mattermost server to the authenticated Moed integration API.
settings_schema.footer: The Service Token and Instance ID must exactly match the Moed deployment settings. Restarting Mattermost is not required after saving.

settings.help_text: Canonical external URL of the Moed application, without a trailing slash.
A random secret of at least 32 characters. Use the same value as DNR_MATTERMOST_TOKEN_FILE in Moed.
Stable identifier for this Mattermost server. Use the same value as DNR_MATTERMOST_INSTANCE_ID in Moed.
Maximum time to wait for Moed. Allowed range: 2–30 seconds.
Allow editors and administrators to bind a channel to one Moed engagement.
